'''Vladimir Vyacheslavovich Boldyrev''' ({{langx|ru|Влади́мир Вячесла́вович Бо́лдырев}}; 8 April 1927 – 9 November 2025) was a Russian chemist. A member of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]], he was a recipient of the [[State Prize of the Russian Federation]] (1993).

Boldyrev died on 9 November 2025, at the age of 98.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://new.ras.ru/staff/akademiki/boldyrev-vladimir-vyacheslavovich/|title=Болдырев Владимир Вячеславович|work=Росси́йская акаде́мия нау́к|access-date=27 November 2025|language=Russian}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.prometeus.nsc.ru/science/schools/boldyrev/|title=Академик Владимир Вячеславович Болдырев|work=В.В.Болдырев|first1=К.И.|last1=Елкина|first2=C.К.|last2=Канн|access-date=27 November 2025|language=Russian}}</ref>
